title: QA Pilot Checklist Evidence Linker
description: Schema for QA Pilot checklist evidence linker packets. A linker validates whether evidence refs inside an evidence checklist (#44) point to real, existing pipeline artifacts across the sealed advisory layers (#33-#45). Reports each link as found, missing, or stale with aggregate status.

source_checklist_id.description: The evidence checklist whose refs are being validated.

title.description: Human-readable title for this link check.

description.description: What this link check covers and which stores were scanned.

item_id.description: The checklist item whose evidence ref is being checked.

pipeline_layer.description: The sealed pipeline layer that should contain this evidence.

ref.description: The specific evidence reference being resolved (e.g. file path, index key, packet ID).

status.description: Link resolution status: found=exists, missing=not found, stale=exists but outdated.

detail.description: Additional detail about the link status (e.g. why stale, what was expected vs found).

expected_path.description: Expected filesystem or store path for the referenced evidence.

links.description: Individual link checks from checklist items to pipeline evidence stores.

missing_refs.description: List of refs that were not found.

stale_refs.description: List of refs that were found but are stale.

aggregate.description: Aggregate link-resolution status across all checked refs.

advisory_only.description: All QA Pilot linkers are advisory. Must be true.

librarian_impact.description: No Librarian mutation permitted. Must be none.

not_seal_authority.description: Explicit assertion that this linker does not confer sealing authority.

not_librarian_mutation_authority.description: Explicit assertion that this linker does not authorize Librarian mutation.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this linker was created.

created_by.description: Agent or tool that created this linker.

pipeline_refs.description: References to the sealed pipeline layers whose stores were scanned.

allOf.description: If missing > 0, aggregate.missing_refs must be non-empty.
If stale > 0, aggregate.stale_refs must be non-empty.
all_found must be true when missing=0 and stale=0, false otherwise.
